name: Storm Lightning for SSE and VR (Minty Lightning 2019)
notes: SKSE lightning (up to 50 flashes/s). Flashes are game light spikes; Bearforj weather presets blend over ~4 s so the look does not pump with every flash; the image analyzer may report flicker during storms (expected). Do not use old Lightning During Storms with it. MCM can lower flash brightness.
